messages:
Nora (Finance): Morning team, noticed an unexpected $42k GPU line on the Feb invoice under project=hosted-models. It is tagged customer=enterprise-x but team=null. Need rapid ownership mapping for provisional chargeback.

billing-bot: Alert: gpu_anomaly detected for project=hosted-models. Spike start 2026-02-11. Details: /alerts/177950.

Diego (Infra): Can you paste the raw invoice rows or run cost-lookup? Untagged rows usually leak into shared.

Nora (Finance): Paste: `2026-02-13 hosted-models gpu V100 $42,000 tags: team=null,customer=enterprise-x,job=hf-grid-quant`

Kai (ML): `hf-grid-quant` is from our hyperparam sweep. We spun up a large grid for latency tuning around 02/11026. We should have used preemptible templates but I think one batch used `gpu-large-locked`.

Diego (Infra): Run this query to confirm owner mapping:
```
cost-lookup --project hosted-models --from 2026-02-10 --to 2026-02-15 --filter "job=hf-grid-quant" --group-by instance_id,template
```
I can also map job -> repo -> CODEOWNERS to attribute to Kai's team.

Nora (Finance): We need a best-effort allocation now. If ML covers >$20k we need director approval for transfers.

Kai (ML): Confirmed it's us. We used wrong template for batch #7. We'll absorb up to $20k but need a transfer for the remainder. How should we request?

Nora (Finance): File FIN-5099 in finance-tools with the provisional invoice CSV and justification. I'll pre-approve up to $20k; anything above goes to finance director. Also please include steps to avoid recurrence so we can close the ticket quickly.

Diego (Infra): Short-term mitigation: added mandatory `team` enforcement on submit and a pre-submit warning if template contains `no-preempt` or `locked`. Also set a soft 48h cap for sweep templates.

billing-bot: Ticket created FIN-5099 by Nora (Finance) 8 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5099

Kai (ML): Thanks. We'll rerun the remaining experiments with preemptible nodes and add a postmortem to the ML board.
